messages:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: increased model load failures for rwd-13b-q4 in us-west1. Error% jump to 22% on /v1/chat. Incident INC-4981. Details: https://incidents.redwood/INC-4981

alex_oncall: grabbing logs now. seeing repeated container OOM (137) + kubernetes restarts on node gke-usw1-n2-4b2c.

priya_runtime: paste log snippet:
```
[2026-04-02T03:12:05Z] artifact: start deserialize
[2026-04-02T03:12:07Z] allocate 4.1GiB temporary buffer
[2026-04-02T03:12:07Z] cuda: cuInit returned 999 (unknown error)
[2026-04-02T03:12:10Z] process killed by OOM (137)
[2026-04-02T03:12:11Z] jit: compile op aten::matmul timeout after 90s
```

sam_sre: that cuInit 999 looks like driver flakiness — maybe node GPU crashed then restarted causing deserializer to retry and explode memory.

maya_cs: Customer impact: WalletCorp reporting 503s since 03:10 UTC. I opened a bridge with them and escalated to enterprise support.

alex_oncall: Quick plan: 1) cordon affected node(s), 2) lower load concurrency for rwd-13b-q4 to 1, 3) route WalletCorp to rwd-13b-q2 (quantized), 4) disable auto-burst warmups for rwd-13b-q4.

priya_runtime: running now:
```
kubectl cordon gke-usw1-n2-4b2c
kubectl delete pod model-loader-rwd-13b-q4-8 -n prod --grace-period=0
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: model-settings
  namespace: prod
data:
  rwd-13b-q4.max_load_concurrency: "1"
EOF
```

devin_engineer: I captured the artifact header from the failing pod: artifact_format: v3.1, runtime expects v3.3. The v3.1 path materializes a full tensor table during parse. That transient allocation + GPU driver restart = cascade.

sam_sre: mitigation effective so far — no new 137s for 9m. Error rate for rwd-13b-q4 down to 3.5%. WalletCorp errors on fallback route ~1.2%.

maya_cs: WalletCorp on the bridge accepts fallback for now but wants ETA for restore and root cause.

alex_oncall: short ETA: keep fallback + gating for 20-40m. medium ETA: produce preprocessed artifact (strip heavy metadata) & test in staging -> 8-12h. full fix: add streaming deserializer & warmup memory quotas -> 1-3 days.

priya_runtime: additional defensive step: purge compile cache and restart warmup on safe nodes to avoid JIT timeouts repeating:
```
kubectl exec -n prod warmup-runner -- bash -lc "rm -rf /var/lib/model/compile_cache/* && systemctl restart model-warmup"
```

devin_engineer: I can produce a conversion tool to upgrade v3.1->v3.3 artifacts without full re-export. Will try to generate a preprocessed artifact that avoids the large intermediate. Estimates: 6-10h to build + test.

sam_sre: severity escalated to P1 (enterprise impacted). Paging: handoff planned to sam_sre in 35m.

alex_oncall: handoff checklist: - ensure WalletCorp informed (maya_cs), - keep fallback routing, - keep node cordoned until image/driver verified, - attach header/sample to INC-4981.

maya_cs: WalletCorp update pushed: on fallback, latency +25-40ms on heavy requests, no errors for non-batched calls. They requested hourly updates until resolved.

priya_runtime: note — we saw 'cuda: cuInit returned 999' on two nodes around same time. Ops should verify kernel/drivers on those nodes; could be rolling GPU driver instability.

devin_engineer: saving sample artifact and header into the ticket now. Will also push a staging artifact for validation.

incident-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/INC-4981. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/model-warmup. Logs archived: s3://incidents/INC-4981/2026-04-02-03-12.log

sam_sre: Ill take pager. Continuing monitoring and coordinating driver checks with infra. If error rate >5% or new node restarts, I will page the on-call infra team.

alex_oncall: handing over. Adding devin & priya as postmortem owners.

priya_runtime: will follow up with RCA and mitigation PRs: (1) streaming parser, (2) warmup concurrency guard, (3) warmup memory quota per node.

sam_sre: ack. updating INC-4981 with timeline and attaching probe metrics.

maya_cs: closing customer bridge for now; will reopen if anything changes. Customer expects final RCA within 72h.

incident-bot: Thread archived to INC-4981 after handoff. Last snapshot stored at s3://incidents/INC-4981/final-2026-04-02-03-47.log
